about: Three d100 rolls: what triggers the Weakness, what it does, and for how long. If every Power is Remarkable or lower, a Fatal result may be taken as Incapacitation instead.

stimulus.name: Elemental Allergy
stimulus.summary: An ounce or more of one pure element within 20 feet.

stimulus.name: Molecular Allergy
stimulus.summary: A specific compound, such as water, wood or Adamantium.

stimulus.name: Energy Depletion
stimulus.summary: The hero's Power runs down and must be recharged.

stimulus.name: Energy Dampening
stimulus.summary: Pent-up energy harms the hero if he cannot use his Powers.

stimulus.name: Finite Limit
stimulus.summary: Each Power has a limited number of uses.

stimulus.name: Psychological
stimulus.summary: A condition that affects the hero's mind.

effect.name: Power Negation
effect.summary: Powers stop working near the stimulus.

effect.name: Incapacitation
effect.summary: Loses 1 Health a turn, stopping at zero.

effect.name: Fatal
effect.summary: Loses Health, then Endurance, and can die.

duration.name: Continuous with Contact
duration.summary: Lasts while the stimulus is in range.

duration.name: Limited Duration with Contact
duration.summary: Starts at contact and lasts 1-100 turns.

duration.name: Permanent
duration.summary: Runs its full course even if contact is broken.
